visualReview.notes: All nine portable and nine shared frames inspected, including full-resolution gallery. Tapered cast-iron plates, fine seam/rivet geometry, three-pane openings, brackets, gallery rails, lantern and entrance steps render intact.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Painted metal keeps both broad white bands continuous while fine plate seams remain visible. Gallery bracket faces and curved shaft show coherent shading; no faceted lighting or disconnected hardware found.

geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped circular tower center and diameter align with the orthographic footprint. Operator conservation-plan west-face photograph establishes the window-row direction; opposite entry position is the documented exterior reconstruction. Terrain supplies ordinary ground contact.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: The official conservation plan provides the 39m cast-iron taper, two white bands, narrow three-pane windows, gallery brackets, white foundation and mahogany door. Detached station houses remain separate mapped features; fine current corrosion varies over time and uses the shared painted-metal surface.
